title: Pay walls
note: Each line is a fee or paid-copy offer a body made in reply to a request. None has been paid.

items.note: Pay wall: RCAHMW (Royal Commission) asks £20 per high-resolution scan for high-resolution scans of microfiche and archive material (Great House Farm holdings); not paid
Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £15.60 first image, £4.80 each further image; £60.00 per hour for multiple documents for digital images of catalogued items (online order form); not paid
Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks quote offered, no figure given for digital copies of any relevant records found (2026/2370); not paid
Pay wall: RCAHMW (Royal Commission) asks per price list (figure not given in the reply) for document summary service; not paid
Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £19.50 (scanned image £3.40 + VAT, reproduction £12.85 + VAT) for digital copy of a newspaper extract; not paid
Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £38.50 next day or £12.50 standard post for copy certificates (two family records, 1990); not paid
Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £60 (including VAT) for up to one hour, payable in advance for staff research in burial and parish register entries; not paid
Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £15.60 inclusive of VAT for copy of DBDT79/1 (1877 lease) and its plan; not paid
Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £50 including copies of relevant entries for staff search of rate books UC/73/1–5 and later volumes, with copies of entries; not paid
Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £50 including copies of relevant pages for staff search of planning minutes for 1992/00671/RES and what they lead to; not paid

Pay wall: RCAHMW (Royal Commission) asks charged search, per price list (scans free for orders under five) for aerial photograph searches and further searches (list of air-photo sorties; complex enquiries); not paid
Pay wall: ITV Archive asks £70 up to 15 min; £95 up to 30 min; £145 up to 60 min; £195 up to 90 min; £245 over 90 min, per programme for digital copies of programmes from the archive; not paid
Pay wall: The National Archives asks paid search under the Public Records Act fees regulations, no figure given for search for the Valuation Office Survey 1910 entries (OS Glamorgan); not paid
Pay wall: Companies House asks £3 per document; £9 per pre-1973 accounts or annual return; £20 archive DVD for archive documents for Mountjoy Ltd (1926) and later companies (COH2382411X); not paid
Pay wall: Mount Stuart (Bute archive) asks £20 per day for research visits for research visit to the Bute Estate (Glamorgan) records; not paid
Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks paid search offered, no figure given for search of the closed 1988 Weekly Orders (South Wales Constabulary records); not paid

Pay wall: Cardiff Central Library asks scan cost via Glamorgan Archives; research charged, no figure given for scan of Bute X.6(12) (1877 trustee accounts) via Glamorgan Archives; detailed research; not paid
Pay wall: British Geological Survey asks £12 + VAT per plan, or £18 + VAT where a hard copy must be scanned for PDF copies of mine and borehole plans (IDA 312230); not paid

Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £50 an hour plus VAT, including a digitised image of any item found for staff searches of the remaining references (2026/4097): UC/73/1–5, DCVG/C/4/36, D696, DBDT/18/1, DBDT/79/1, ACA/8/2, estimated 1–3 hours each; not paid

Pay wall: RICS Library asks £10 + VAT per item retrieved, up to £250 + VAT for 25 volumes; scanning £15 + VAT per item up to 15 pages, £13 + VAT per further 15 pages; day pass £18 + VAT for RICS Year Books 1969–1993 (25 annual directory volumes); not paid
